title: Spring Cleaning
synopsis: Sam asks Kit to take a stray comic off the README; Kit removes it and finds one last sentence still pointing at it.
altText: Panel 1: Sam points at a comic on the README and says it doesn't belong there; Kit agrees. Panel 2: Kit deletes the image and the file. Panel 3: Glitch pops up from a sentence that still says 'the comic above'. Panel 4: Kit fixes the sentence and Sam says the page is clean.

panels.scene: Sam points at a comic on the README

dialogue.speaker: sam
dialogue.text: That comic doesn't belong in the README.

panels.scene: Kit removes the image and deletes the file
Glitch pops out of a leftover sentence

dialogue.speaker: glitch
dialogue.text: Ha! 'That's what drew the comic above.' What comic?

panels.scene: Kit trims the sentence and Sam is happy
